entity_raw.definition_raw:
You employ ruthlessness and malice to command other races of goblinoids to do your bidding.

Prerequisite(s): Cha 13, hobgoblin.

Benefit(s): You receive a +5 competence bonus on Knowledge (local) checks and Charisma-based skill checks regarding other goblinoids. If you have the Leadership feat, treat your leadership score as 2 higher when taking followers or a cohort with the goblinoid subtype.
